+            rep.fail(f"{path}.name", "required field missing")

+            rep.fail(f"{path}.licenseConcluded", "required field missing (may be NOASSERTION)")

+                             f"evidence fileName {pfe.get('fileName')!r} != component")

+                    algo = c.get("algorithm")

+                    if actual and c.get("checksumValue") != actual:
+                        rep.fail(f"{path}.evidence.packageFileEvidence({algo})",
+                                 "evidence checksum mismatch vs disk")

+                loc = (le.get("evidenceLocation") or "").lstrip("./")
+                try:

+                except OSError:
+                    rep.fail(f"{path}.evidence.licenseEvidence.evidenceLocation",

+    # ---- relationships ----
+    for ri, r in enumerate(doc.get("relationships", [])):
+        path = f"relationships[{ri}]"
+        for field in ("spdxElementId", "relationshipType", "relatedSpdxElement"):
+            if not r.get(field):
+                rep.fail(f"{path}.{field}", "required field missing")
+        if r.get("relationshipType") not in RELATIONSHIP_TYPES:
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.relationshipType", f"unknown type {r.get('relationshipType')!r}")

+                rep.fail(f"{path}.{ref}", f"dangling reference {r[ref]!r}")

+        if not o.get("licenseId"):
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.licenseId", "required field missing")
+        if not o.get("extractedText"):
+            rep.fail(f"{path}.extractedText", "required field missing")
+        if o.get("licenseId") in SPDX_LIST_LICENSES:
+            rep.warn(f"{path}.licenseId",
+                     f"{o['licenseId']} is on the SPDX License List; "
+                     "hasExtractedLicensingInfos should only hold non-list licenses")
+
+    # ---- document describes ----
+    has_describes = any(
+        r.get("relationshipType") == "DESCRIBES" and r.get("spdxElementId") == "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT"
+        for r in doc.get("relationships", [])
+    ) or bool(doc.get("documentDescribes"))
+    if not has_describes and (packages or files):
+        rep.warn("document", "no DESCRIBES relationship or documentDescribes pointing at content")

+def main():
+    doc = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
+    rep = validate(doc)
+    rep.print()
+    sys.exit(1 if rep.fails else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
